title: CapCut Masters Class
description: A full CapCut apprenticeship: timeline craft, pacing, captions, sound design, effects discipline, and exporting short-form video that holds attention end to end on social platforms.

lessons.title: CapCut as a Short-Form Edit Bay

introduction.text: CapCut is built for fast social editing: timeline cuts, captions, effects, and platform exports. Speed without an edit plan creates noisy videos. This apprenticeship trains end-to-end short-form craft—from rough cut to captioned, mixed, export-ready stories.

project.title: Edit Plan Card
project.description: Write a 20–30s edit plan: hook (0–3s), problem, demo/proof, CTA. List shot types needed and what you will refuse to add (effect clutter list).

questions.question: Hooks must earn:
options: Continued watch in the first seconds
questions.correctAnswer: Continued watch in the first seconds

questions.question: CTA placement is often best:
options: After value is shown, still early enough to act
questions.correctAnswer: After value is shown, still early enough to act

lessons.title: Timeline Craft: Cuts, Pacing, and Structure

introduction.text: Pacing is meaning. Cut on intention: remove air, keep breaths that sell emotion. Alternate wide/detail when it helps comprehension. Use J/L patterns conceptually—let sound lead picture when useful. Structure beats: hook, develop, payoff.

questions.question: Removing air means:
options: Deleting all silence including emotional beats
Trimming dead time that adds nothing
questions.correctAnswer: Trimming dead time that adds nothing

questions.question: Detail shots help when:
options: Viewers need to understand a small action
questions.correctAnswer: Viewers need to understand a small action

questions.question: Cutting on intention means:
options: Each cut advances story or energy
Only using jump cuts for errors
questions.correctAnswer: Each cut advances story or energy

questions.question: Emotional breaths can be kept when:

lessons.title: Captions, On-Screen Text, and Accessibility

introduction.text: Most social video is watched without sound at first. Captions are product, not garnish. Keep lines short, high-contrast, and timed to speech. Avoid covering faces and key actions. Style captions to brand without sacrificing readability.

lessons.title: Effects and Transitions with Restraint

introduction.text: Effects should motivate: emphasize a beat, hide a jump, or match brand motion language. Unmotivated transitions scream amateur template. Build a small approved effect set. If you remove an effect and the story holds, you probably did not need it.

questions.question: Motivated effects:
options: Serve a story or emphasis reason
questions.correctAnswer: Serve a story or emphasis reason

questions.question: The removal test asks:
options: Whether story still holds without the effect
questions.correctAnswer: Whether story still holds without the effect

project.title: Effect Budget

questions.question: Template-y feel comes from:

questions.correctAnswer: Overused default packs without story link
